description: Lists/searches the reference taxonomy of business categories (e.g. gcid:restaurant). Category names (categories/gcid:...) feed location.categories on update_location and categoryName on list_attribute_metadata. view=FULL also returns serviceTypes and moreHoursTypes per category; filter narrows by display name, e.g. "displayName=coffee".

languageCode.description: BCP 47 language for display names, e.g. "en".

regionCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code the categories should be valid in, e.g. "US".

view.description: BASIC (default) returns name + displayName; FULL adds serviceTypes and moreHoursTypes.

name: list_categories
title: Search business categories
